message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the federal long‑weekends in Canada for 2023. (Note that some provinces observe additional holidays—if you need those, let me know!)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Jan 1–2 (Sun–Mon) |
| **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | Apr 7–9 (Fri–Sun) |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | May 20–22 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Jul 1–3 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | Sep 2–4 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | Oct 7–9 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Monday Nov 11 | Nov 9–11 (Sat–Mon) |
| **Christmas** | Monday Dec 25 | Dec 23–25 (Sat–Mon) |

These are the federal holidays that create a three‑day weekend (or longer if you count the preceding or following day). If you’re looking for provincial holidays that also turn into long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Ontario, British Columbia, etc.), just give me a shout!
